title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: A hot fall‑82 show captured on a solid matrix tape, highlighted by a smoking Morning Dew and a fierce Other One.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its high energy, especially the scorching Morning Dew, The Other One, Going Down the Road and a rare Spanish Bollero. Reviewers also rave about the clear, well‑balanced matrix recording, calling it one of the best versions of this show. Overall the concert delivers a fiery second set and strong band interplay.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average ~4.3), frequent praise of both the musical performance and the recording quality, with no notable complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers describe the mix as crisp, awesome and the best version available; no drop‑outs or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as sweet, spicy and "Szechuan"‑like, with strong transitions; first set ends intriguingly with Throwing Stones into Deal.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Generally praised – his voice and guitar work are highlighted as great, especially on Morning Dew and High Time (though one reviewer notes a slight crack in his voice).
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for powerful bass "rocking the place" and even taking vocal duties; conducts The Other One and responds to crowd chants.
band_member_comments.Keys: Noted that Brent Mydland did not sing background vocals on this night, but his keyboard playing was still strong.
